# awscc_bedrock_session (Resource)

Definition of AWS::Bedrock::Session Resource Type



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `encryption_key_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the KMS key to use to encrypt the session data.
- `session_metadata` (Map of String) A map of key-value pairs containing attributes to be persisted across the session.
- `tags` (Attributes List) A list of tags associated with the session. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp for when the session was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `last_updated_at` (String) The timestamp for when the session was last modified.
- `session_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the session.
- `session_id` (String) The unique identifier of the session in UUID format.
- `session_status` (String) The current status of the session.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value of the tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_bedrock_session.example
  identity = {
    session_arn = "session_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `session_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the session

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_bedrock_session.example
  id = "session_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_bedrock_session.example "session_arn"
```
